metadata.title: Public Health Analytics-OS data-quality and comparability profile

scope: Interpretation safeguards for a balanced 30-indicator India pilot; no observed values are assessed.

evidenceState: Source-aware analyst guidance; domain review pending

rules: An expected lag is never invented when the cited source does not state one.
A validation check is a review safeguard, not proof that a value is valid.
Comparability is conditional on compatible definition, numerator, denominator, period, geography and source version.
The profile does not rate programme performance or data quality without observed values.
Analyst guidance remains visibly distinct from source-stated metadata and domain-reviewed evidence.
publicationBoundary: Metadata-only pilot. No person-level or aggregate values, automated exclusions, performance ratings or public bulk-download controls.
